coordinates: Normalized UV [0,1] of the round unfurled pancake; screen projection is applied after folds.

state_fields.coverage: Dynamic per-pancake alpha mask in common UV; transparent holes survive every transform.
state_fields.side_a_heat: Independent stored heat/state for side A.
state_fields.side_b_heat: Independent stored heat/state for side B.
state_fields.visible_side: A or B, changed only after flip.
state_fields.fillings: Per-type spread alpha mask or array of portion UV positions, kept until removal or hidden under folded surface.
state_fields.fold_history: Ordered actual gesture hinge lines and current fold angles, not a snapped success icon.

roll.method: Continuous mesh roll from user's gesture extent; partial fraction remains open.

error_policy: Preserve actual gesture hinge and angle, coverage holes, cooking state and fillings. fold-incorrect.png is one authored example, not an exhaustive set of all failures.
static_form_usage: Standalone art for shape previews, recipes and visual targets for a correctly cooked pancake. For gameplay combinations, render the stored surface and layers with mesh deformation; do not replace a burned/holed pancake with the baked golden final-form image.
guide_usage: guide-batter-circle.svg and guide-filling-marker.svg are mathematical shapes, projected into each destination surface. Number and placement of portion markers are configurable; no final balance values are assigned.
